411:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
412:     # Main run
413:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
414: 
415:     def run(self, ticker: str, trade_date: str, asset_type: str = "stock") -> RunResult:
416:         run_id = f"run-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
417:         evidence_log = EvidenceLog()
418:         budget = BudgetTracker(max_calls=self.settings.max_calls)
419: 
420:         from .evidence import EvidenceRecorder
421: 
422:         recorder = EvidenceRecorder(evidence_log, budget)
423:         evidence_log.record(
424:             "run_start",
425:             run_id=run_id,
426:             ticker=ticker,
427:             trade_date=trade_date,
428:             context_mode=self.context_mode,
429:             data_mode=self.data_mode,
430:             budget_max_calls=self.settings.max_calls,
431:         )
432: 
433:         config = dict(self.graph_config)
434:         config.setdefault("checkpoint_enabled", False)
435:         config.setdefault("results_dir", str(self.settings.home_path / "logs"))
436: 
437:         frozen_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
438:         frozen_identity: dict[str, Any] | None = None
439:         if self.data_mode == "frozen" and self.source_pack is not None:
440:             frozen_snapshot = self.source_pack.input.data_snapshot
441:             frozen_identity = self.source_pack.input.identity
442: 
443:         self._run_events = evidence_log.events
444:         graph = EvidenceTradingGraph(
445:             self.settings.analysts,
446:             debug=False,
447:             config=config,
448:             callbacks=[recorder],
449:             data_mode=self.data_mode,
450:             evidence_log=evidence_log,
451:             data_snapshot=frozen_snapshot,
452:             frozen_identity=frozen_identity,
453:         )
454: 
455:         # Identity: recorded by the graph override; needed for context constraints.
456:         instrument_context = graph.resolve_instrument_context(ticker, asset_type)
457:         identity = graph.last_identity
458: 
459:         assembly = self._assemble_context(ticker, trade_date, identity)
460:         evidence_log.record(
461:             "context_assembled",
462:             mode=assembly.mode,
463:             chars=assembly.chars,
464:             blocks=assembly.blocks,
465:             deduplicated=assembly.deduplicated,
466:             truncated=assembly.truncated,
467:             token_heuristic=assembly.token_heuristic,
468:         )
469: 
470:         init_state = graph.propagator.create_initial_state(
471:             ticker,
472:             trade_date,
473:             asset_type=asset_type,
474:             past_context=assembly.text,
475:             instrument_context=instrument_context,
476:         )
477:         args = graph.propagator.get_graph_args(callbacks=[recorder])
478: 
479:         trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
480:         start = time.time()
481:         outcome = RunOutcome.COMPLETED
482:         error: str | None = None
483:         try:
484:             for chunk in graph.graph.stream(init_state, **args):
485:                 trace.append(chunk)
486:         except BudgetExhausted as exc:
487:             outcome = RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED
488:             evidence_log.record("budget_stop", limit=exc.limit)
489:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface any graph failure
490:             logger.exception("graph run failed for %s on %s", ticker, trade_date)
491:             outcome = RunOutcome.FAILED
492:             error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
493:             evidence_log.record("run_error", error=error)
494:         wall_seconds = time.time() - start
495: 
496:         final_state = merge_trace(trace)
497:         usage = budget.summary()
498:         usage.stop_reason = budget.stop_reason()
499: 
500:         signal = None
501:         if outcome == RunOutcome.COMPLETED and "final_trade_decision" in final_state:
502:             signal = graph.process_signal(final_state["final_trade_decision"])
503:             evidence_log.record("run_end", outcome="completed", signal=signal, wall_seconds=round(wall_seconds, 3))
504:         elif outcome == RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED:
505:             evidence_log.record(
506:                 "run_end",
507:                 outcome="budget_stopped",
508:                 note="incomplete research returned; no approvable recommendation",
509:             )
510:         else:
511:             evidence_log.record("run_end", outcome="failed")
512: 
513:         # Reports (deterministic rebuild from the final state).
514:         report_dir = self.settings.runs_dir / run_id / "report"
515:         report_files: list[str] = []
516:         if final_state:
517:             try:
518:                 complete = write_report_tree(final_state, ticker, report_dir)
519:                 report_files = [str(p) for p in report_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
520:                 report_files.append(str(complete))
521:             except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - reports are best-effort
522:                 logger.warning("report write failed: %s", exc)
523: 
524:         # Proposal (only a completed, tradeable signal with evidence price).
525:         proposal = None
526:         proposal_error: str | None = None
527:         snapshot = self._data_snapshot_from_run(final_state, frozen_snapshot)
528:         try:
529:             proposal = decide_proposal(
530:                 outcome=outcome.value,
531:                 signal=signal,
532:                 run_id=run_id,
533:                 ticker=ticker,
534:                 trade_date=trade_date,
535:                 snapshot=snapshot,
536:             )
537:         except ReviewError as exc:
538:             proposal_error = str(exc)
539:         if outcome == RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED:
540:             proposal = None  # incomplete research must not be approvable (NFR-003)
541: 
542:         input_snapshot = InputSnapshot(
543:             instrument_context=instrument_context,
544:             past_context=assembly.text,
545:             initial_state=_trim_state(init_state),
546:             identity=identity,
547:             data_snapshot=self._data_snapshot_from_run(final_state, frozen_snapshot),
548:             memory_used=self._memory_entries(ticker, trade_date),
549:             memory_sources=["tradingagents.memory_log" if self.data_mode == "live" else "frozen-pack"],
550:         )
551: 
552:         manifest = RunManifest(
553:             run_id=run_id,
554:             ticker=ticker,
555:             trade_date=trade_date,
556:             asset_type=asset_type,
557:             analysts=list(self.settings.analysts),
558:             context_mode=self.context_mode,
559:             data_mode=self.data_mode,
560:             outcome=outcome.value,
561:             signal=signal,
562:             prompt_version=self.settings.prompt_version,
563:             created_at=utcnow_iso(),
564:             operator="research-desk",
565:             model_quick=self.graph_config.get("quick_think_llm"),
566:             model_deep=self.graph_config.get("deep_think_llm"),
567:             budget_max_calls=self.settings.max_calls,
568:             source_pack=self.source_pack.manifest.run_id if self.source_pack is not None else None,
569:             reason=proposal_error,
570:         )
571: 
572:         from .evidence import build_pack
573: 
574:         pack = build_pack(
575:             manifest=manifest,
576:             input_snapshot=input_snapshot,
577:             events=evidence_log.events,
578:             final_state=final_state,
579:             usage=usage,
580:             proposal=proposal,
581:             reports_written=report_files,
582:         )
583:         run_dir = self.settings.runs_dir / run_id
584:         self.io.export(pack, run_dir)
585:         pack_path = str(run_dir)
586: 
587:         return RunResult(
588:             run_id=run_id,
589:             ticker=ticker,
590:             trade_date=trade_date,
591:             outcome=outcome.value,
592:             signal=signal,
593:             usage=usage,
594:             events=evidence_log.events,
595:             final_state=final_state,
596:             proposal=proposal,
597:             pack_path=pack_path,
598:             error=error,
599:             stop_reason=usage.stop_reason,
600:         )
601: 
602:     def _data_snapshot_from_run(
603:         self, final_state: dict[str, Any], frozen_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]]
604:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
605:         """The tool-data snapshot a run consumed: frozen input plus live tool results.
606: 
607:         For live runs the snapshot is rebuilt from the recorded tool events so
608:         the evidence pack is self-contained; for frozen reruns the frozen
609:         snapshot is authoritative.
610:         """
611:         if self.data_mode == "frozen":
612:             return frozen_snapshot
613:         from .evidence import _data_snapshot_from_events
614: 
615:         return _data_snapshot_from_events(getattr(self, "_run_events", []))
616: 
617: 
618: # Bound the initial-state copy stored in evidence: LangChain message objects are
619: # not JSON-serialisable, so keep the scalar fields that matter for provenance.
620: _SERIALISABLE_STATE_FIELDS = (
621:     "company_of_interest",
622:     "asset_type",
623:     "instrument_context",
624:     "trade_date",
625:     "past_context",
626: )
627: 
628: 
629: def _trim_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
630:     return {k: state[k] for k in _SERIALISABLE_STATE_FIELDS if k in state}

  topology and every agent are untouched.

There is no monkeypatching of global state, no replacement of upstream agents
and no toy pipeline: the frozen-tool variant is the same compiled graph with
the same nodes, only its data source is frozen.

``ResearchRunner`` orchestrates one run: assemble context (baseline/compact),
stream the graph with the evidence recorder + budget, capture the final state,
derive the signal deterministically, write reports, and create a PENDING_REVIEW
proposal when the signal is tradeable.
"""

_NO_DATA_SENTINEL = (
    "NO_DATA_AVAILABLE: frozen evidence contains no result for this exact tool "
    "call. Do not estimate or fabricate values — report that data is unavailable."
)


def _frozen_lookup(snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]], name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Look up a frozen tool result by canonical args; return a NO_DATA sentinel otherwise."""
    table = snapshot.get(name, {})
    key = json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    if key in table:
        return table[key]
    # The real get_indicators splits a comma-separated list; mirror that so a
    # frozen rerun serves each requested indicator it has evidence for.
    if name == "get_indicators" and isinstance(args.get("indicator"), str):
        parts = [i.strip().lower() for i in args["indicator"].split(",") if i.strip()]
        if len(parts) > 1:
            results = []
            for ind in parts:
                sub = dict(args, indicator=ind)
                sub_key = json.dumps(sub, sort_keys=True, default=str)
                if sub_key in table:
                    results.append(table[sub_key])
            if results:
                return "\n\n".join(results)
    return _NO_DATA_SENTINEL

# Module-level snapshot target swapped by ``set_frozen_snapshot`` per run; the
# frozen tools read it. This is not monkeypatching upstream — it is the frozen
# tool body's own data source.
_FROZEN_SNAPSHOT: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}


def set_frozen_snapshot(snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]]) -> None:
    global _FROZEN_SNAPSHOT
    _FROZEN_SNAPSHOT = snapshot or {}


class EvidenceTradingGraph(TradingAgentsGraph):
    """TradingAgentsGraph subclass that records direct data paths and can freeze evidence."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        selected_analysts=("market", "news"),
        debug=False,
        config: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        callbacks: list | None = None,
        *,
        data_mode: str = "live",
        evidence_log: EvidenceLog | None = None,
        data_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None,
        frozen_identity: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ):
        self.data_mode = data_mode
        self.evidence_log = evidence_log
        self.data_snapshot = data_snapshot or {}
        self._frozen_identity = frozen_identity
        self.last_identity: dict[str, Any] = {}
        set_frozen_snapshot(self.data_snapshot)
        super().__init__(selected_analysts=selected_analysts, debug=debug, config=config, callbacks=callbacks)

    def _create_tool_nodes(self) -> dict[str, ToolNode]:
        if self.data_mode != "frozen":
            return super()._create_tool_nodes()
        return {
            "market": ToolNode(
                [
                    _frozen_get_stock_data,
                    _frozen_get_indicators,
                    _frozen_get_verified_market_snapshot,
                ]
            ),
            "social": ToolNode([_frozen_get_news]),
            "news": ToolNode(
                [
                    _frozen_get_news,
                    _frozen_get_global_news,
                    _frozen_get_insider_transactions,
                    _frozen_get_macro_indicators,
                    _frozen_get_prediction_markets,
                ]
            ),
            "fundamentals": ToolNode([]),
        }

    def resolve_instrument_context(self, ticker: str, asset_type: str = "stock") -> str:
        """Resolve identity (live lookup or frozen), record it, build the context string."""
        if self.data_mode == "frozen" and self._frozen_identity is not None:
            identity = dict(self._frozen_identity)
        else:
            identity = resolve_instrument_identity(ticker)
        self.last_identity = identity
        if self.evidence_log is not None:
            record_data_read(
                self.evidence_log,
                "instrument_identity",
                ticker,
                identity,
                node="graph.resolve_instrument_context",
            )
        return build_instrument_context(ticker, asset_type, identity)

    def _fetch_returns(
        self, ticker: str, trade_date: str, holding_days: int = 5, benchmark: str = "SPY",
    ) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, int | None, str | None]:
        """Record the realized-returns read; skip network resolution on frozen reruns."""
        if self.data_mode == "frozen":
            if self.evidence_log is not None:
                record_data_read(
                    self.evidence_log,
                    "realized_returns",
                    ticker,
                    {"mode": "frozen", "skipped": True, "trade_date": trade_date},
                    node="graph.resolve_pending_entries",
                )
            return None, None, None, None
        result = super()._fetch_returns(ticker, trade_date, holding_days, benchmark)
        if self.evidence_log is not None:
            record_data_read(
                self.evidence_log,
                "realized_returns",
                ticker,
                {
                    "trade_date": trade_date,
                    "holding_days": holding_days,
                    "raw_return": result[0],
                    "alpha_return": result[1],
                    "resolution_date": result[3],
                },
                node="graph.resolve_pending_entries",
            )
        return result


def price_from_evidence(snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]], ticker: str) -> float | None:
    """Extract the latest close for ``ticker`` from frozen get_stock_data evidence.

    This is the only price source for proposals — the operator never types a
    price. Returns ``None`` when no price evidence exists (the proposal then
    cannot be approved until evidence is supplied).
    """
    import csv
    import io

    table = snapshot.get("get_stock_data", {})
    best: float | None = None
    for result in table.values():
        if not result.startswith("# Stock data for"):
            continue
        # Skip the leading '#' comment lines so DictReader sees the real header.
        csv_lines = [ln for ln in result.splitlines() if ln and not ln.startswith("#")]
        if not csv_lines:
            continue
        try:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO("\n".join(csv_lines))))
        except Exception:
            continue
        for row in reversed(rows):
            close = row.get("Close")
            if close:
                try:
                    best = float(close)
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                break
    return best


def merge_trace(trace: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    final_state: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for chunk in trace:
        final_state.update(chunk)
    return final_state


def decide_proposal(
    *,
    outcome: str,
    signal: str | None,
    run_id: str,
    ticker: str,
    trade_date: str,
    snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
) -> ProposalRecord | None:
    """Decide whether a run yields a PENDING_REVIEW proposal.

    The single place that enforces "a budget-stopped or failed run is never
    approvable, and REVIEW/Hold do not trade". Tradeable signals are only
    Buy/Overweight; the price must come from evidence.
    """
    if outcome != RunOutcome.COMPLETED.value:
        return None  # budget-stopped / failed runs never become approvable (NFR-003)
    if not signal or is_review(signal):
        return None
    if signal not in ("Buy", "Overweight"):
        return None
    price = price_from_evidence(snapshot, ticker)
    if price is None:
        return None  # price must come from evidence; no price -> nothing to review
    try:
        return create_proposal(
            run_id=run_id,
            ticker=ticker,
            trade_date=trade_date,
            signal=signal,
            rating=signal,
            price=price,
        )
    except ReviewError:
        return None


class ResearchRunner:
    """Runs one research session against the real graph and produces evidence + proposal."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: ResearchDeskSettings,
        *,
        context_mode: str = "baseline",
        data_mode: str = "live",
        source_pack: Any = None,
        graph_config: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        llm_factory: Callable[..., tuple[Any, Any]] | None = None,
    ):
        self.settings = settings
        self.context_mode = context_mode
        self.data_mode = data_mode
        self.source_pack = source_pack
        self.graph_config = graph_config or {}
        self.llm_factory = llm_factory
        self.io = EvidencePackIO()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Memory / context source
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _memory_entries(self, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if self.data_mode == "frozen" and self.source_pack is not None:
            return self.source_pack.input.memory_used
        from tradingagents.agents.utils.memory import TradingMemoryLog

        log = TradingMemoryLog(self.graph_config)
        return [e for e in log.load_entries() if e.get("ticker") == ticker]

    def _assemble_context(self, ticker: str, trade_date: str, identity: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        prices: dict[str, float] = {}
        if self.data_mode == "frozen" and self.source_pack is not None:
            snap = self.source_pack.input.data_snapshot
            price = price_from_evidence(snap, ticker)
            if price is not None:
                prices["last_close"] = price
        constraints = StandingConstraints(
            ticker=ticker,
            trade_date=trade_date,
            identity=identity,
            prices=prices,
            policy={
                "initial_cash": "USD 100000",
                "max_single_position": "10% of equity",
                "integer_shares": "yes",
                "no_shorting": "yes",
            },
            current_task=(
                f"Produce the research-desk analysis of {ticker} on {trade_date} "
                "for US equities (market + news analysts)."
            ),
        )
        assembler = ContextAssembler(constraints)
        entries = self._memory_entries(ticker, trade_date)
        return assembler.assemble_from_entries(entries, self.context_mode)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main run
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def run(self, ticker: str, trade_date: str, asset_type: str = "stock") -> RunResult:
        run_id = f"run-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
        evidence_log = EvidenceLog()
        budget = BudgetTracker(max_calls=self.settings.max_calls)

        from .evidence import EvidenceRecorder

        recorder = EvidenceRecorder(evidence_log, budget)
        evidence_log.record(
            "run_start",
            run_id=run_id,
            ticker=ticker,
            trade_date=trade_date,
            context_mode=self.context_mode,
            data_mode=self.data_mode,
            budget_max_calls=self.settings.max_calls,
        )

        config = dict(self.graph_config)
        config.setdefault("checkpoint_enabled", False)
        config.setdefault("results_dir", str(self.settings.home_path / "logs"))

        frozen_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
        frozen_identity: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        if self.data_mode == "frozen" and self.source_pack is not None:
            frozen_snapshot = self.source_pack.input.data_snapshot
            frozen_identity = self.source_pack.input.identity

        self._run_events = evidence_log.events
        graph = EvidenceTradingGraph(
            self.settings.analysts,
            debug=False,
            config=config,
            callbacks=[recorder],
            data_mode=self.data_mode,
            evidence_log=evidence_log,
            data_snapshot=frozen_snapshot,
            frozen_identity=frozen_identity,
        )

        # Identity: recorded by the graph override; needed for context constraints.
        instrument_context = graph.resolve_instrument_context(ticker, asset_type)
        identity = graph.last_identity

        assembly = self._assemble_context(ticker, trade_date, identity)
        evidence_log.record(
            "context_assembled",
            mode=assembly.mode,
            chars=assembly.chars,
            blocks=assembly.blocks,
            deduplicated=assembly.deduplicated,
            truncated=assembly.truncated,
            token_heuristic=assembly.token_heuristic,
        )

        init_state = graph.propagator.create_initial_state(
            ticker,
            trade_date,
            asset_type=asset_type,
            past_context=assembly.text,
            instrument_context=instrument_context,
        )
        args = graph.propagator.get_graph_args(callbacks=[recorder])

        trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        start = time.time()
        outcome = RunOutcome.COMPLETED
        error: str | None = None
        try:
            for chunk in graph.graph.stream(init_state, **args):
                trace.append(chunk)
        except BudgetExhausted as exc:
            outcome = RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED
            evidence_log.record("budget_stop", limit=exc.limit)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface any graph failure
            logger.exception("graph run failed for %s on %s", ticker, trade_date)
            outcome = RunOutcome.FAILED
            error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            evidence_log.record("run_error", error=error)
        wall_seconds = time.time() - start

        final_state = merge_trace(trace)
        usage = budget.summary()
        usage.stop_reason = budget.stop_reason()

        signal = None
        if outcome == RunOutcome.COMPLETED and "final_trade_decision" in final_state:
            signal = graph.process_signal(final_state["final_trade_decision"])
            evidence_log.record("run_end", outcome="completed", signal=signal, wall_seconds=round(wall_seconds, 3))
        elif outcome == RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED:
            evidence_log.record(
                "run_end",
                outcome="budget_stopped",
                note="incomplete research returned; no approvable recommendation",
            )
        else:
            evidence_log.record("run_end", outcome="failed")

        # Reports (deterministic rebuild from the final state).
        report_dir = self.settings.runs_dir / run_id / "report"
        report_files: list[str] = []
        if final_state:
            try:
                complete = write_report_tree(final_state, ticker, report_dir)
                report_files = [str(p) for p in report_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
                report_files.append(str(complete))
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - reports are best-effort
                logger.warning("report write failed: %s", exc)

        # Proposal (only a completed, tradeable signal with evidence price).
        proposal = None
        proposal_error: str | None = None
        snapshot = self._data_snapshot_from_run(final_state, frozen_snapshot)
        try:
            proposal = decide_proposal(
                outcome=outcome.value,
                signal=signal,
                run_id=run_id,
                ticker=ticker,
                trade_date=trade_date,
                snapshot=snapshot,
            )
        except ReviewError as exc:
            proposal_error = str(exc)
        if outcome == RunOutcome.BUDGET_STOPPED:
            proposal = None  # incomplete research must not be approvable (NFR-003)

        input_snapshot = InputSnapshot(
            instrument_context=instrument_context,
            past_context=assembly.text,
            initial_state=_trim_state(init_state),
            identity=identity,
            data_snapshot=self._data_snapshot_from_run(final_state, frozen_snapshot),
            memory_used=self._memory_entries(ticker, trade_date),
            memory_sources=["tradingagents.memory_log" if self.data_mode == "live" else "frozen-pack"],
        )

        manifest = RunManifest(
            run_id=run_id,
            ticker=ticker,
            trade_date=trade_date,
            asset_type=asset_type,
            analysts=list(self.settings.analysts),
            context_mode=self.context_mode,
            data_mode=self.data_mode,
            outcome=outcome.value,
            signal=signal,
            prompt_version=self.settings.prompt_version,
            created_at=utcnow_iso(),
            operator="research-desk",
            model_quick=self.graph_config.get("quick_think_llm"),
            model_deep=self.graph_config.get("deep_think_llm"),
            budget_max_calls=self.settings.max_calls,
            source_pack=self.source_pack.manifest.run_id if self.source_pack is not None else None,
            reason=proposal_error,
        )

        from .evidence import build_pack

        pack = build_pack(
            manifest=manifest,
            input_snapshot=input_snapshot,
            events=evidence_log.events,
            final_state=final_state,
            usage=usage,
            proposal=proposal,
            reports_written=report_files,
        )
        run_dir = self.settings.runs_dir / run_id
        self.io.export(pack, run_dir)
        pack_path = str(run_dir)

        return RunResult(
            run_id=run_id,
            ticker=ticker,
            trade_date=trade_date,
            outcome=outcome.value,
            signal=signal,
            usage=usage,
            events=evidence_log.events,
            final_state=final_state,
            proposal=proposal,
            pack_path=pack_path,
            error=error,
            stop_reason=usage.stop_reason,
        )

    def _data_snapshot_from_run(
        self, final_state: dict[str, Any], frozen_snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]]
    ) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
        """The tool-data snapshot a run consumed: frozen input plus live tool results.

        For live runs the snapshot is rebuilt from the recorded tool events so
        the evidence pack is self-contained; for frozen reruns the frozen
        snapshot is authoritative.
        """
        if self.data_mode == "frozen":
            return frozen_snapshot
        from .evidence import _data_snapshot_from_events

        return _data_snapshot_from_events(getattr(self, "_run_events", []))


# Bound the initial-state copy stored in evidence: LangChain message objects are
# not JSON-serialisable, so keep the scalar fields that matter for provenance.
_SERIALISABLE_STATE_FIELDS = (
    "company_of_interest",
    "asset_type",
    "instrument_context",
    "trade_date",
    "past_context",
)


def _trim_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {k: state[k] for k in _SERIALISABLE_STATE_FIELDS if k in state}

"""Context assembly for research runs: baseline vs compact.

The upstream graph already injects a ``past_context`` (memory lessons) and an
``instrument_context`` (resolved identity) into the initial state. This module
owns the *assembly of that context string* so a compact configuration can
genuinely shrink the prompt while preserving the invariants the task requires:

- stock identity, analysis date, key prices,
- standing constraints (the simulated policy numbers), current task,
- de-duplicated repeated text,
- bounded earlier history.

Compaction never removes agents or the graph; it only changes the text that is
assembled into the initial ``past_context``. The honest size metric recorded
offline is the number of characters assembled; actual LLM token usage comes
from provider ``usage_metadata`` during a run.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .models import ContextMode


@dataclass
class StandingConstraints:
    """Identity/date/price/policy facts that must survive compaction."""

    ticker: str = ""
    trade_date: str = ""
    identity: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    prices: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # label -> last price
    policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # teaching policy numbers
    current_task: str = ""

    def header_text(self) -> str:
        lines = ["STANDING ANALYSIS CONSTRAINTS (always true for this run):"]
        lines.append(f"- Instrument identity: {self.ticker}")
        if self.identity.get("company_name"):
            lines.append(f"- Company: {self.identity['company_name']}")
        if self.identity.get("sector"):
            lines.append(f"- Sector/industry: {self.identity['sector']} / {self.identity.get('industry', '')}")
        lines.append(f"- Analysis date: {self.trade_date}")
        for label, price in self.prices.items():
            lines.append(f"- Key price ({label}): {price}")
        for key, value in self.policy.items():
            lines.append(f"- Standing constraint - {key}: {value}")
        if self.current_task:
            lines.append(f"- Current task: {self.current_task}")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def dedup_repeated_blocks(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove exact duplicate paragraph blocks, keeping first occurrence order.

    Operates on blank-line-separated blocks so repeated analyst reports in a
    long history collapse to one copy instead of being sent N times.
    """
    if not text:
        return text
    blocks = list(text.split("\n\n"))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    kept: list[str] = []
    for block in blocks:
        key = block.strip()
        if not key:
            continue
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        kept.append(block)
    return "\n\n".join(kept)


def bound_history(text: str, max_chars: int = 6000) -> str:
    """Bound total assembled history length by truncating from the tail."""
    if not text:
        return text
    if len(text) <= max_chars:
        return text
    # Cut at a block boundary near the limit so we never split mid-paragraph.
    cut = text.rfind("\n\n", 0, max_chars)
    if cut == -1:
        cut = max_chars
    return text[:cut].rstrip() + "\n\n[... earlier history truncated ...]"


def estimate_token_heuristic(text: str) -> int:
    """Deterministic English-token heuristic for offline comparisons.

    This is a *character-based heuristic*, explicitly NOT claimed as provider
    token counts; real token numbers come from LLM usage metadata. It exists so
    offline tests can assert that compact genuinely assembles less context.
    """
    if not text:
        return 0
    return max(1, (len(text) + 3) // 4)


@dataclass
class AssemblyResult:
    text: str
    mode: str
    chars: int
    blocks: int
    token_heuristic: int
    deduplicated: int = 0
    truncated: bool = False


class ContextAssembler:
    """Assembles the injected ``past_context`` for baseline or compact runs.

    Baseline keeps the raw memory text (matching upstream behavior) but still
    re-injects the standing constraints so both arms share the same invariants.
    Compact additionally de-duplicates repeated blocks and bounds earlier
    history, then re-appends the constraints. The same assembler, same source
    material, and same graph are used for both arms — only the assembly differs.
    """

    # Baseline keeps history nearly whole (hard ceiling only as a safety net);
    # compact applies a tighter cap so older discussion is genuinely compressed.
    DEFAULT_HARD_MAX_CHARS = 20000
    DEFAULT_COMPACT_MAX_CHARS = 6000
    DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 5

    def __init__(self, constraints: StandingConstraints | None = None, **kwargs):
        self.constraints = constraints or StandingConstraints()
        self.hard_max_chars = kwargs.get("hard_max_chars", self.DEFAULT_HARD_MAX_CHARS)
        self.compact_max_chars = kwargs.get(
            "compact_max_chars", self.DEFAULT_COMPACT_MAX_CHARS
        )
        self.max_entries = kwargs.get("max_entries", self.DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES)

    def assemble(self, memory_text: str, mode: str | ContextMode) -> AssemblyResult:
        mode = ContextMode(mode)
        constraints = self.constraints.header_text()
        body = dedup_repeated_blocks(memory_text)
        deduped = (
            len([b for b in memory_text.split("\n\n") if b.strip()])
            - len([b for b in body.split("\n\n") if b.strip()])
            if memory_text
            else 0
        )
        cap = self.hard_max_chars if mode == ContextMode.BASELINE else self.compact_max_chars
        truncated = len(body) > cap
        body = bound_history(body, cap)
        text = _join_parts(constraints, body)
        return AssemblyResult(
            text=text,
            mode=mode.value,
            chars=len(text),
            blocks=len([b for b in text.split("\n\n") if b.strip()]),
            token_heuristic=estimate_token_heuristic(text),
            deduplicated=deduped,
            truncated=truncated,
        )

    def assemble_from_entries(
        self,
        entries: list[dict[str, Any]],
        mode: str | ContextMode,
        as_of: str | None = None,
    ) -> AssemblyResult:
        """Assemble from structured memory entries (TradingMemoryLog shape).

        When ``as_of`` (yyyy-mm-dd) is given, entries whose outcome was only
        resolved after that date are excluded, so a historical run cannot learn
        from the future (SEC-001/AT-02). Entries with no recorded resolution
        date are kept but explicitly marked as not suitable for historical
        evaluation.
        """
        if not entries:
            return self.assemble("", mode)
        parts = []
        seen_bodies: set[str] = set()
        deduplicated = 0
        for e in entries:
            resolved = e.get("resolved")
            if as_of is not None and resolved and resolved > as_of:
                continue  # outcome not known by the trade date — exclude
            decision = (e.get("decision") or "").strip()
            reflection = (e.get("reflection") or "").strip()
            # De-duplicate repeated report *bodies* regardless of the differing
            # tag date, keeping the first occurrence for traceability.
            body = f"{decision}\n{reflection}".strip()
            if body:
                if body in seen_bodies:
                    deduplicated += 1
                    continue
                seen_bodies.add(body)
            tag = (
                f"[{e.get('date', '')} | {e.get('ticker', '')} | "
                f"{e.get('rating', '')}]"
            )
            if as_of is not None and not resolved:
                tag += " [availability: unknown — not suitable for historical evaluation]"
            block = tag
            if decision:
                block += f"\nDECISION:\n{decision}"
            if reflection:
                block += f"\nREFLECTION:\n{reflection}"
            parts.append(block)
        recent = parts[-self.max_entries :]
        result = self.assemble("\n\n".join(recent), mode)
        result.deduplicated += deduplicated
        return result


def _join_parts(constraints: str, body: str) -> str:
    if not body:
        return constraints
    return constraints + "\n\n" + body

"""Proposal review state machine and simulated-ledger execution.

Flow: research produces a PENDING_REVIEW proposal. A trusted CLI operator
approves or rejects it. Execution re-evaluates the *current* ledger against the
deterministic policy before writing; the approval binds the exact proposal
version, so a changed proposal cannot ride an old approval. Re-executing an
already-simulated proposal is a no-op (idempotence).

No LLM path reaches this module: the research graph only ever writes a proposal
in PENDING_REVIEW, and only the CLI review/execute/ledger commands touch it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .models import (
    ExecutionRecord,
    ProposalRecord,
    ProposalStatus,
    TransactionRecord,
    TransactionStatus,
    make_proposal_version,
    utcnow_iso,
)
from .policy import evaluate_buy


class ReviewError(Exception):
    """Business rejection with a stable message; the ledger stays unchanged."""


def _proposal_content_version(proposal: ProposalRecord) -> str:
    """Fingerprint of the proposal's tradeable inputs, independent of status."""
    return make_proposal_version(
        proposal.ticker, proposal.trade_date, proposal.signal, proposal.price
    )


def create_proposal(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    ticker: str,
    trade_date: str,
    signal: str,
    rating: str | None,
    price: float | None,
    proposal_id: str | None = None,
) -> ProposalRecord:
    """Create a PENDING_REVIEW proposal from a completed research run.

    Only tradeable signals become proposals. Hold/REVIEW (and any signal the
    graph marked REVIEW) never produce a tradeable recommendation, matching the
    requirement that REVIEW and Hold do not trade.
    """
    if signal in ("Hold", "REVIEW", "Sell", "Underweight"):
        raise ReviewError(
            f"signal {signal!r} is not tradeable in v1; no proposal is created "
            "(REVIEW and Hold do not trade)"
        )
    pid = proposal_id or f"prop-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    return ProposalRecord(
        proposal_id=pid,
        run_id=run_id,
        ticker=ticker,
        trade_date=trade_date,
        signal=signal,
        rating=rating,
        price=price,
        status=ProposalStatus.PENDING_REVIEW,
        proposal_version=_proposal_content_version(
            ProposalRecord(
                proposal_id=pid,
                run_id=run_id,
                ticker=ticker,
                trade_date=trade_date,
                signal=signal,
                rating=rating,
                price=price,
            )
        ),
        created_at=utcnow_iso(),
    )


def approve(
    proposal: ProposalRecord,
    *,
    shares: int,
    operator: str,
) -> ProposalRecord:
    """Approve an exact proposal version with an operator-supplied share count.

    The approval is bound to the proposal's *content* version, so if the run's
    material inputs (ticker/date/signal/price) later change, the old approval
    no longer matches and execution requires review.
    """
    if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
        raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
    if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED:
        raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is rejected and cannot be approved")
    # REVIEW_REQUIRED is a safe-fail state, not a dead end: after the operator
    # reviews the current evidence, they may approve the corrected version.
    if not operator:
        raise ReviewError("approval requires an operator identity")
    if not isinstance(shares, int) or shares <= 0:
        raise ReviewError(f"shares must be a positive integer, got {shares!r}")
    if proposal.price is None or proposal.price <= 0:
        raise ReviewError(
            f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} has no evidence price; cannot approve without price"
        )
    proposal.shares = shares
    proposal.operator = operator
    proposal.status = ProposalStatus.APPROVED
    proposal.approved_at = utcnow_iso()
    proposal.approved_version = _proposal_content_version(proposal)
    return proposal


def reject(proposal: ProposalRecord, *, operator: str, reason: str = "rejected by operator") -> ProposalRecord:
    if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
        raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
    proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REJECTED
    proposal.operator = operator
    proposal.reason = reason
    return proposal


def execute(
    store, proposal: ProposalRecord, *, operator: str,
) -> tuple[ProposalRecord, ExecutionRecord]:
    """Re-evaluate the current ledger and simulate the approved buy (or reject).

    Steps (each observable, none partial):
    1. Idempotence: an already-SIMULATED proposal returns its stored execution.
    2. Version binding: the current proposal content must match the approved
       version; otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED (AT-05).
    3. Re-read the current ledger and run the deterministic policy.
    4. On any failure: return REVIEW_REQUIRED / BLOCKED with reasons; ledger
       unchanged. On success: apply the transaction atomically.
    """
    if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
        existing = proposal.execution or ExecutionRecord(executed=True)
        existing.reason = "already executed"
        return proposal, existing

    current_version = _proposal_content_version(proposal)
    # A stale approval for different content is checked before status: an
    # approved proposal whose run inputs changed must not execute the new
    # version (AT-05), even though the row now carries the new content.
    if proposal.approved_version is not None and proposal.approved_version != current_version:
        proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED
        proposal.reason = (
            "approval no longer matches the proposal content (version changed "
            f"approved={proposal.approved_version!r} current={current_version!r}); "
            "re-review against the current ledger"
        )
        store.update_proposal_status(
            proposal.proposal_id,
            ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED,
            operator=operator,
            reason=proposal.reason,
        )
        return proposal, ExecutionRecord(
            executed=False, reason=proposal.reason, policy_checks=[]
        )
    if proposal.status != ProposalStatus.APPROVED:
        proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED
        proposal.reason = (
            f"proposal is not APPROVED (status={proposal.status.value}) and cannot "
            "execute; approve it against the current ledger first"
        )
        store.update_proposal_status(
            proposal.proposal_id,
            ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED,
            operator=operator,
            reason=proposal.reason,
        )
        return proposal, ExecutionRecord(
            executed=False, reason=proposal.reason, policy_checks=[]
        )

    if proposal.shares is None or proposal.price is None:
        proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED
        proposal.reason = "proposal missing shares or evidence price; cannot execute"
        store.update_proposal_status(
            proposal.proposal_id, ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED, operator=operator,
            reason=proposal.reason,
        )
        return proposal, ExecutionRecord(executed=False, reason=proposal.reason, policy_checks=[])

    ledger = store.get_ledger()
    if ledger is None:
        raise ReviewError("ledger is not initialised")
    verdict = evaluate_buy(ledger, proposal.shares, proposal.price)
    if not verdict.allowed:
        reasons = [f"{c['check']}: {c['detail']}" for c in verdict.checks if not c["passed"]]
        proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED
        proposal.reason = "policy failed at execution time: " + "; ".join(reasons)
        store.update_proposal_status(
            proposal.proposal_id, ProposalStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED, operator=operator,
            reason=proposal.reason,
        )
        return proposal, ExecutionRecord(
            executed=False,
            reason=proposal.reason,
            policy_checks=verdict.checks,
            equity_before=ledger.equity,
        )

    tx_id = f"tx-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    execution = ExecutionRecord(
        executed=True,
        tx_id=tx_id,
        policy_checks=verdict.checks,
        equity_before=ledger.equity,
        equity_after=ledger.equity,
        cash_delta=-proposal.shares * proposal.price,
    )
    tx = TransactionRecord(
        tx_id=tx_id,
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id,
        ticker=proposal.ticker,
        side="buy",
        shares=proposal.shares,
        price=proposal.price,
        cash_delta=execution.cash_delta,
        equity_before=ledger.equity,
        equity_after=ledger.equity,
        status=TransactionStatus.SIMULATED,
        policy_checks=verdict.checks,
        operator=operator,
        created_at=utcnow_iso(),
    )
    store.apply_transaction(tx, execution)
    proposal.status = ProposalStatus.SIMULATED
    proposal.execution = execution
    updated = store.get_proposal(proposal.proposal_id)
    return updated or proposal, proposal.execution


def evaluate_proposal_legibility(proposal: ProposalRecord) -> list[str]:
    """Non-mutating advisory checks used by the CLI ledger/report views."""
    issues: list[str] = []
    if proposal.status != ProposalStatus.APPROVED:
        issues.append(f"not APPROVED (status={proposal.status.value})")
    if proposal.shares is None or proposal.price is None:
        issues.append("missing shares or evidence price")
    return issues


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f") + "Z"

"""Readable markdown reports for runs, proposals and the ledger.

Reports are the human-facing evidence/provenance view: run manifest + config +
input snapshot + event/usage summary + signal + proposal, the ledger state, and
the proposal review trail. They are pure rendering (no calls).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .models import EvidencePack, LedgerState, ProposalRecord


def render_run_report(pack: EvidencePack) -> str:
    m = pack.manifest
    lines = [
        f"# Research Desk Run Report: {m.ticker} on {m.trade_date}",
        "",
        f"- run_id: `{m.run_id}`",
        f"- outcome: `{m.outcome}`",
        f"- signal: `{m.signal or 'n/a'}`",
        f"- context mode: `{m.context_mode}`",
        f"- data mode: `{m.data_mode}`",
        f"- analysts: {', '.join(m.analysts)}",
        f"- prompt version: `{m.prompt_version}`",
        f"- created at: {m.created_at}",
        f"- source pack: {m.source_pack or 'none (original run)'}",
        f"- budget max calls: {m.budget_max_calls}",
        "",
        "## Usage",
        "",
        f"- LLM calls: {pack.usage.calls}",
        f"- input tokens: {pack.usage.input_tokens}",
        f"- output tokens: {pack.usage.output_tokens}",
        f"- total tokens: {pack.usage.total_tokens}",
        f"- stop reason: {pack.usage.stop_reason}",
        "",
        "## Input snapshot",
        "",
        f"- instrument context chars: {len(pack.input.instrument_context)}",
        f"- past context chars: {len(pack.input.past_context)}",
        f"- identity: {pack.input.identity or '{}'}",
        f"- frozen tool data: {sum(len(v) for v in pack.input.data_snapshot.values())} entries",
        f"- memory sources: {', '.join(pack.input.memory_sources) or 'none'}",
        "",
        "## Events",
        "",
    ]
    kinds = {}
    for ev in pack.events:
        kinds[ev.kind] = kinds.get(ev.kind, 0) + 1
    lines.append("| kind | count |")
    lines.append("|---|---|")
    for kind, count in sorted(kinds.items()):
        lines.append(f"| {kind} | {count} |")
    if pack.proposal is not None:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "## Proposal",
                "",
                render_proposal_report(pack.proposal),
            ]
        )
    if pack.reports_written:
        lines.extend(["", "## Reports written", ""])
        lines.extend(f"- `{p}`" for p in pack.reports_written)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def render_proposal_report(prop: ProposalRecord) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"### Proposal `{prop.proposal_id}`",
        "",
        f"- status: `{prop.status.value}`",
        f"- run: `{prop.run_id}`",
        f"- ticker: {prop.ticker} on {prop.trade_date}",
        f"- signal: {prop.signal}",
        f"- price (from evidence): {prop.price}",
        f"- shares (operator): {prop.shares}",
        f"- proposal version: `{prop.proposal_version}`",
        f"- operator: {prop.operator or 'n/a'}",
        f"- approved version: {prop.approved_version or 'n/a'}",
        f"- reason: {prop.reason or 'n/a'}",
    ]
    if prop.execution is not None:
        ex = prop.execution
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "#### Execution",
                "",
                f"- executed: {ex.executed}",
                f"- tx_id: {ex.tx_id or 'n/a'}",
                f"- equity before: {ex.equity_before}",
                f"- equity after: {ex.equity_after}",
                f"- cash delta: {ex.cash_delta}",
                f"- reason: {ex.reason or 'n/a'}",
            ]
        )
        if ex.policy_checks:
            lines.extend(["", "##### Policy checks", ""])
            lines.append("| check | passed | detail |")
            lines.append("|---|---|---|")
            for c in ex.policy_checks:
                lines.append(f"| {c['check']} | {c['passed']} | {c['detail']} |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def render_ledger_report(ledger: LedgerState, transactions: list[dict], proposals: list[ProposalRecord]) -> str:
    lines = [
        "# Research Desk Ledger",
        "",
        f"- last updated: {ledger.last_updated}",
        f"- cash: **USD {ledger.cash:,.2f}**",
        f"- equity: **USD {ledger.equity:,.2f}**",
        "",
        "## Positions",
        "",
    ]
    if ledger.positions:
        lines.append("| ticker | shares | avg price | value |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for ticker, pos in sorted(ledger.positions.items()):
            value = pos.shares * (pos.avg_price or 0.0)
            lines.append(f"| {ticker} | {pos.shares} | {pos.avg_price or 'n/a'} | {value:,.2f} |")
    else:
        lines.append("_none_")
    lines.extend(["", "## Proposals", ""])
    if proposals:
        lines.append("| id | ticker | signal | price | shares | status |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for p in proposals:
            lines.append(
                f"| {p.proposal_id} | {p.ticker} | {p.signal} | {p.price or 'n/a'} | "
                f"{p.shares or 'n/a'} | {p.status.value} |"
            )
    else:
        lines.append("_none_")
    lines.extend(["", "## Transactions", ""])
    if transactions:
        lines.append("| tx_id | proposal | ticker | shares | price | cash delta | equity | status |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for t in transactions:
            lines.append(
                f"| {t['id']} | {t['proposal_id']} | {t['ticker']} | {t['shares']} | "
                f"{t['price']} | {t['cash_delta']:,.2f} | {t['equity_after']:,.2f} | {t['status']} |"
            )
    else:
        lines.append("_none_")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def render_compare_report(baseline: dict, compact: dict) -> str:
    """Table rendering for a baseline/compact comparison (FR-003)."""
    lines = [
        "# Baseline / Compact Comparison",
        "",
        "Same graph, same frozen evidence; only the context assembly differs.",
        "",
        "| metric | baseline | compact | delta |",
        "|---|---|---|---|",
    ]

    def row(name: str, b, c, fmt="{:.1f}") -> str:
        return f"| {name} | {fmt.format(b)} | {fmt.format(c)} | {_delta(b, c)} |"

    lines.append(row("LLM calls", baseline["calls"], compact["calls"], "{:.0f}"))
    lines.append(row("input tokens", baseline["input_tokens"], compact["input_tokens"]))
    lines.append(row("output tokens", baseline["output_tokens"], compact["output_tokens"]))
    lines.append(row("total tokens", baseline["total_tokens"], compact["total_tokens"]))
    lines.append(row("wall time (s)", baseline["wall_seconds"], compact["wall_seconds"]))
    lines.append(f"| stop reason | {baseline['stop_reason']} | {compact['stop_reason']} | — |")
    lines.append(f"| context chars | {baseline['context_chars']} | {compact['context_chars']} | {_delta(baseline['context_chars'], compact['context_chars'])} |")
    lines.append(f"| signal | {baseline['signal'] or 'n/a'} | {compact['signal'] or 'n/a'} | — |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _delta(b: float, c: float) -> str:
    if b == 0:
        return "—"
    pct = (c - b) / b * 100
    return f"{pct:+.1f}%"

display.text:
"""SQLite persistence for the simulated ledger and proposals, plus JSON pack IO.

The simulated ledger is deliberately separate from upstream TradingAgents'
research memory: research memory records decisions for reflection, while this
ledger records executable, operator-approved transactions. Both live in the
desk home, and neither stores credentials.

SQLite is used with ``PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL`` and a single writer so the
approve/execute re-read is atomic; every ledger change is written inside a
transaction and references the approved proposal version and the deterministic
policy checks that passed (INV-001).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .config import INITIAL_CASH
from .models import (
    ExecutionRecord,
    LedgerPosition,
    LedgerState,
    ProposalRecord,
    ProposalStatus,
    TransactionRecord,
    utcnow_iso,
)

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ledger_state (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    cash REAL NOT NULL,
    last_updated TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS positions (
    ticker TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    shares INTEGER NOT NULL,
    avg_price REAL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proposals (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    signal TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating TEXT,
    price REAL,
    shares INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    proposal_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    operator TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    approved_at TEXT,
    approved_version TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    execution_json TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
    side TEXT NOT NULL,
    shares INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price REAL NOT NULL,
    cash_delta REAL NOT NULL,
    equity_before REAL NOT NULL,
    equity_after REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    policy_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    operator TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


class ResearchDeskStore:
    """Thin SQLite wrapper for ledger + proposals.

    Not an ORM: methods are few and map directly to the review/ledger commands
    so the deterministic policy logic stays readable and testable.
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path: str | Path):
        self.db_path = Path(db_path)
        self.db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path))
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
        self._conn.commit()
        # Seed the single ledger row on first use.
        if self.get_ledger() is None:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO ledger_state (id, cash, last_updated) VALUES (1, ?, ?)",
                (INITIAL_CASH, utcnow_iso()),
            )
            self._conn.commit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ledger
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def get_ledger(self) -> LedgerState | None:
        row = self._conn.execute("SELECT cash, last_updated FROM ledger_state WHERE id=1").fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        positions: dict[str, LedgerPosition] = {}
        for p in self._conn.execute("SELECT ticker, shares, avg_price FROM positions").fetchall():
            positions[p["ticker"]] = LedgerPosition(
                ticker=p["ticker"], shares=p["shares"], avg_price=p["avg_price"]
            )
        return LedgerState(cash=row["cash"], positions=positions, last_updated=row["last_updated"])

    def apply_transaction(self, tx: TransactionRecord, execution: ExecutionRecord) -> None:
        """Atomically apply a simulated buy transaction and record it.

        Re-reads the current ledger inside the write transaction so a concurrent
        approve/execute cannot double-apply a stale balance. The caller (review
        policy) has already re-evaluated the ledger; this is the commit step.
        """
        with self._conn:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT cash FROM ledger_state WHERE id=1"
            ).fetchone()
            new_cash = row["cash"] + tx.cash_delta
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE ledger_state SET cash=?, last_updated=? WHERE id=1",
                (new_cash, utcnow_iso()),
            )
            pos = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT shares, avg_price FROM positions WHERE ticker=?", (tx.ticker,)
            ).fetchone()
            if pos is None:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO positions (ticker, shares, avg_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (tx.ticker, tx.shares, tx.price),
                )
            else:
                new_shares = pos["shares"] + tx.shares
                total_cost = (pos["shares"] * (pos["avg_price"] or 0.0)) + (tx.shares * tx.price)
                new_avg = total_cost / new_shares if new_shares else 0.0
                self._conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE positions SET shares=?, avg_price=? WHERE ticker=?",
                    (new_shares, new_avg, tx.ticker),
                )
            self._conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO transactions
                   (id, proposal_id, ticker, side, shares, price, cash_delta,
                    equity_before, equity_after, status, policy_json, operator, created_at)
                   VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
                (
                    tx.tx_id, tx.proposal_id, tx.ticker, tx.side, tx.shares, tx.price,
                    tx.cash_delta, tx.equity_before, tx.equity_after, tx.status.value,
                    json.dumps(tx.policy_checks), tx.operator, tx.created_at,
                ),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE proposals SET status=?, execution_json=? WHERE id=?",
                (
                    ProposalStatus.SIMULATED.value,
                    json.dumps(execution.model_dump()),
                    tx.proposal_id,
                ),
            )

    def list_transactions(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM transactions ORDER BY created_at"
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Proposals
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def save_proposal(self, proposal: ProposalRecord) -> None:
        # Carry over a prior approval binding when content is re-saved: an
        # approved proposal whose run inputs later change keeps its approved
        # version so execution detects the stale approval (AT-05). Fresh
        # (PENDING_REVIEW) proposals keep None.
        prior = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT approved_at, approved_version, operator FROM proposals WHERE id=?",
            (proposal.proposal_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        carry_approved_at = proposal.approved_at
        carry_approved_version = proposal.approved_version
        carry_operator = proposal.operator
        if prior is not None and (prior["approved_version"] is not None):
            carry_approved_at = proposal.approved_at or prior["approved_at"]
            carry_approved_version = proposal.approved_version or prior["approved_version"]
            carry_operator = proposal.operator or prior["operator"]
        with self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """INSERT OR REPLACE INTO proposals
                   (id, run_id, ticker, trade_date, signal, rating, price, shares,
                    status, proposal_version, operator, created_at, approved_at,
                    approved_version, reason, execution_json)
                   VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
                (
                    proposal.proposal_id, proposal.run_id, proposal.ticker,
                    proposal.trade_date, proposal.signal, proposal.rating,
                    proposal.price, proposal.shares, proposal.status.value,
                    proposal.proposal_version, carry_operator,
                    proposal.created_at, carry_approved_at,
                    carry_approved_version, proposal.reason,
                    json.dumps(proposal.execution.model_dump()) if proposal.execution else None,
                ),
            )

    def get_proposal(self, proposal_id: str) -> ProposalRecord | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM proposals WHERE id=?", (proposal_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return self._row_to_proposal(row)

    def list_proposals(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[ProposalRecord]:
        if status:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM proposals WHERE status=? ORDER BY created_at", (status,)
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM proposals ORDER BY created_at"
            ).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_proposal(r) for r in rows]

    def update_proposal_status(
        self,
        proposal_id: str,
        status: ProposalStatus,
        operator: str | None = None,
        approved_version: str | None = None,
        reason: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        with self._conn:
            now = utcnow_iso()
            if status == ProposalStatus.APPROVED:
                self._conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE proposals SET status=?, operator=?, approved_at=?,
                       approved_version=?, reason=? WHERE id=?""",
                    (status.value, operator, now, approved_version, reason, proposal_id),
                )
            else:
                self._conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE proposals SET status=?, operator=?, reason=? WHERE id=?""",
                    (status.value, operator, reason, proposal_id),
                )

    def _row_to_proposal(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> ProposalRecord:
        execution = None
        if row["execution_json"]:
            execution = ExecutionRecord(**json.loads(row["execution_json"]))
        return ProposalRecord(
            proposal_id=row["id"],
            run_id=row["run_id"],
            ticker=row["ticker"],
            trade_date=row["trade_date"],
            signal=row["signal"],
            rating=row["rating"],
            price=row["price"],
            shares=row["shares"],
            status=ProposalStatus(row["status"]),
            proposal_version=row["proposal_version"],
            operator=row["operator"],
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            approved_at=row["approved_at"],
            approved_version=row["approved_version"],
            reason=row["reason"],
            execution=execution,
        )

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()


def _json_default(o):
    if hasattr(o, "model_dump"):
        return o.model_dump()
    if hasattr(o, "isoformat"):
        return o.isoformat()
    return str(o)


def write_json(path: str | Path, data: Any) -> None:
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, default=_json_default), encoding="utf-8")


def read_json(path: str | Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    signal: str | None = None
    report_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    policy_verdict: PolicyVerdict | None = None
    policy_bounds: dict | None = None
    external_calls: int = 0  # always 0 for offline replay
    incomplete: bool = False
    error: str | None = None


class ReplayEngine:
    """Rebuilds reports, signal and policy outputs from a complete evidence pack."""

    def __init__(self, io: EvidencePackIO | None = None):
        self.io = io or EvidencePackIO()
        # Deterministic heuristic; the graph constructs it the same way.
        self._signal_processor = SignalProcessor()

    def load(self, source: str | Path) -> EvidencePack:
        return self.io.import_pack(source)

    def replay(
        self,
        source: str | Path | EvidencePack,
        out_dir: str | Path,
        ledger=None,
    ) -> ReplayResult:
        """Rebuild the pack's outputs under ``out_dir`` with no network calls."""
        pack = source if isinstance(source, EvidencePack) else self.load(source)
        result = ReplayResult(pack=pack)

        if pack.manifest.outcome == "completed" and not pack.final_state:
            result.incomplete = True
            result.error = "pack claims completion but has no final_state"
            return result

        signal = None
        if pack.final_state.get("final_trade_decision"):
            signal = self._signal_processor.process_signal(
                pack.final_state["final_trade_decision"]
            )
        result.signal = signal

        out = Path(out_dir)
        try:
            complete = write_report_tree(pack.final_state, pack.manifest.ticker, out)
            result.report_files = [str(p) for p in out.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
            if complete not in result.report_files:
                result.report_files.append(str(complete))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - report rebuild is best-effort
            result.error = f"report rebuild failed: {exc}"

        if ledger is not None and pack.proposal is not None:
            prop = pack.proposal
            result.policy_bounds = policy_bounds(ledger, prop.price)
            if prop.shares is not None and prop.price is not None:
                result.policy_verdict = evaluate_buy(
                    ledger, prop.shares, prop.price
                )
            else:
                result.policy_verdict = PolicyVerdict(
                    allowed=False,
                    checks=[
                        {
                            "check": "proposal_material",
                            "passed": False,
                            "detail": "proposal missing operator shares (supplied at approval); "
                            "policy bounds are reported instead",
                        }
                    ],
                )

        return result
